name: Çatalhöyük roof-access settlement
description: Closely clustered houses at Çatalhöyük were entered from roofs in a densely built settlement without streets.

date.label: Eastern mound occupation approximately 7400–6200 BCE
date.basis: The stated range or year applies to the described evidence or documentary event; it does not establish invention.

events.statement: The site description reports 18 occupation levels on the eastern mound dated 7400–6200 BCE and clustered roof-access houses.
